protocol.architecture: Unidirectional recurrent encoder plus last-query scaled dot-product temporal attention; concatenated last state and attention context; persistence residual
protocol.Q_K_V: Identity projections; Q is last hidden state, K=V are all observed hidden states; no independent projection matrices
protocol.attention_complexity: Single query over L positions; O(LH) attention, no L by L self-attention matrix
protocol.training: Same target/family learning rate as plain grid; AdamW; batch64; 18 steps/epoch; max120 epochs; 15 complete epochs patience; val min_delta1e-5
protocol.logging: Every optimiser update: full train, validation and test eval MSE; flush every row; identical eval mode
protocol.selection: Checkpoint and seven-window selection use validation only; test never used for selection
protocol.target_weights: Independent target networks, same historical G/D/p and calendar inputs; no parameter sharing
protocol.context: 2021 only provides historical input; 2022-2024 fits labels and scalers; 2026 September tail excluded
protocol.test_status: Monitored development holdout, previously viewed; not a blind test
protocol.baseline: Frozen previous plain seed17 grid; matched input/target dates/scalers/lookbacks/rates; small head parameter increase explicitly counted
protocol.device: CPU, independent target processes, two threads each
